outline: The main objective of this course is to study the principle of operation of field oriented induction motor drives. The course contents include:	review of electromagnetic energy conversion,induction machine theory, complex vector model, vector control, current control, PWM, field weakening, and motor parameter measurement.
schedule:
Week:
(1) Electromagnetic energy conversion
(2) Magnetic circuit, attraction force
(3) Induction machine theory
(4) Variable voltage variable frequency control
(5) Complex vector model
(6) Complex vector model
(7) Principle of vector control
(8) Principle of vector control
(9) Mid-term
(10) Three-phase current control
(11) Three-phase current control
(12) PWM inverter
(13) SVPWM
(14) Field weakening control
(15) Field weakening control
(16) Motor parameter measurement
(17) Paper study
(18) Final exam
assessment:
home work：10 ％
mid term exam.: 35%
final exam.: 35%
paper study: 20%
